children.value: matrices. You cannot divide by a matrix - but you can multiply by an inverse matrix, if one exists.

\begin{align*}
    C X + A &= B \\
    CX &= B - A \\
    C^{-1} C X &= C^{-1} (B - A) \textrm{ (multiplying by }C^{-1} \textrm{ on the left on both sides)}\\
    I X &= C^{-1}(B - A) \textrm{(the matrices cancel out to give the identity matrix)}\\
    X &= C^{-1}(B - A).
\end{align*}
